topic: Diversification: do not put all your eggs in one basket.

episode.title: Diversification: One Basket Problem

shots.narration: All your eggs, one basket—what could go wrong?
shots.scene: Bright modern kitchen, vertical 9:16 3D animation, one overflowing egg basket on a small table, no text.
shots.mood: Sunny kitchen, precariously stacked white eggs, Kash's wide confident smile.

shots.narration: Kash's basket starts wobbling on the way to breakfast.
shots.scene: Clean modern kitchen beside a breakfast counter, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash wobbles the overloaded basket in her hands.
shots.mood: Tilted basket, raised eyebrows, playful suspense.

shots.narration: [surprised] Oops! Every egg was riding in that one basket.
shots.scene: Kitchen breakfast counter with an overturned basket, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The eggs tumble from Kash's basket onto the counter.
shots.mood: Cartoon splashes of yolk, Kash's startled face, Coin's concerned expression.

shots.narration: Coin explains: diversification means spreading investments across different baskets.
shots.scene: Bright kitchen table with several small empty baskets, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Coin gestures across the row of baskets.
shots.mood: Friendly gold glow, Kash leaning forward with curious eyes.

shots.narration: For example, imagine ten coins together in one basket.
shots.scene: Kitchen tabletop with ten plain gold tokens in one basket and another empty basket, vertical 9:16, no markings or text.
shots.action: Coin points at the basket holding all ten tokens.
shots.mood: Clear uncluttered arrangement, bright gold tokens, attentive expressions.

shots.narration: [excited] Move five here: now everything isn't in one place.
shots.scene: Kitchen tabletop with two small baskets and ten plain gold tokens, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Coin slides five tokens into the second basket.
shots.mood: Two clearly separated groups, cheerful faces, bright friendly colours.

shots.narration: The point isn't these baskets; it's avoiding one big pile.
shots.scene: Modern kitchen table with the two token baskets spaced apart, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash gestures between the two separated baskets.
shots.mood: Kash's understanding smile, Coin's approving expression, balanced composition.

shots.narration: Kash gets it: don't put every egg together.
shots.scene: Breakfast counter with fresh eggs and two small baskets, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Kash places eggs into the second basket.
shots.mood: Neatly arranged breakfast setting, relaxed shoulders, warm smiles.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Sketch your baskets today; next, what goes inside?
shots.scene: Bright kitchen table with Kash's open notebook, vertical 9:16, pages containing only simple basket drawings, no letters or text.
shots.action: Kash draws several empty basket shapes in her notebook.
shots.mood: Inviting blank basket drawings, Kash's curious smile, Coin peeking eagerly besid

episode.endHook: Next episode: what goes inside those baskets?
episode.description: Kash learns diversification through a tiny egg-basket mishap. Coin uses a simple example to explain spreading investments instead of putting everything in one place. General money education, not personal financial advice.
